question: Motion to Invoke Cloture on the Motion to Proceed: H.R. 7008 — A bill to amend chapter 131 of title 5 to require certain restrictions on stocks for Members of Congress and their spouses and dependents, and for other purposes.
result: Cloture on the Motion to Proceed Rejected (53-47, 3/5 majority required)
plain_language: This was a vote to end debate on taking up the Stop Insider Trading Act, which would bar members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks and would require public notice before a sale. A Yea would have moved the Senate toward taking up the bill. A Nay blocked ending debate.
